lines.text: The people must destroy the nations' worship places, tear down their altars, smash their pillars, and burn their Asherah poles.
The people must go to the place the LORD chooses from among all their tribes, and there they eat and rejoice.
The people may slaughter and eat meat within any of their gates, but they must not eat the blood.
The people must eat their tithes and firstborn at the LORD's chosen place, with their households and the foreigner within their gates.
